replacement_rule: The first preordered reserve CAST08-FIXED3 replaced the excluded RUMP12-THM4.3 after an independent source-only counterexample, before any measured run.
independence_warning: This development corpus contains correlated same-paper tasks and three prior Pilot 23 canaries. It is not a held-out confirmatory sample. Report direct treatment uptake per task and preserve no-use and unfavorable pairs.
admission_gate: No task may run until its current packet passes fresh independent source review, a target-absence/direct-component check, and a compiling full-domain private sorry statement. A hash-bound admission record must cover all twelve before campaign launch.
